column1: TABLE RoommateStatus-dev-shows-v2 - TV show tracker (one item per tracked show, watchers embedded). completedAt is absent while a show is active - its absence is what active means. members season & episode are 1-based. watchpartyStartedAt / watchpartyStartedBy / watchpartyStartedById / watchpartySeason / watchpartyEpisode are set only while a watchparty is live. Keyed (groupId HASH, id RANGE): the group is the partition, so reading a household's feed is one Query and no row can be addressed from another household. The -v2 suffix is historical: this replaced an id-keyed table of the same name, which a key-schema change could not alter in place.
